signal_funnel.definition: raw D+1-fillable BREAKOUT reaching +5R before original stop and >=50% MFE within 120 symbol sessions

winner_episode_coverage.definition: non-overlapping eligible symbol-month anchors reaching +50% within 120 sessions

oracle_exit_bound.definition: same canonical entries/sizes; best pre-original-stop high within 120 sessions
important_limitations: holds position sizes fixed and ignores reinvestment
ignores overlapping-capital and opportunity-cost changes caused by later exits
uses the original hard stop but ignores tighter trailing exits

conclusion.headline: Primary bottleneck: entry signal supply. Raw winner-episode recall=14.8%; major-signal filter recall=31.4%; actual/oracle P&L capture=23.3%.
conclusion.interpretation: The breakout generator misses most major eligible-universe runs; exit tuning cannot monetize opportunities that never become entries.
conclusion.exit_only_can_justify_30pct: No; even the fixed-size hindsight bound remains below 30% CAGR.
conclusion.recommended_next_experiment: the pre-registered pullback-continuation stream, behind a disabled config flag, because it directly targets missing entry supply
